NOTE the adjacency: this skill ALSO ships toolchain/, which is the Docker BUILD CONTEXT
(Dockerfile, mull.yml.template, CMakeLists.*, exit_wrap.cpp, index_slice.py) and is a different

doctor's discovery convention stays exactly one string across every adapter.
Fix hints CITE the Toolchain bringup section of this skill's SKILL.md; they do not replace it.
Everything here runs INSIDE Docker — nothing is compiled on the host — so the probes check the
host-side prerequisites (docker itself, then the built image).
